notes: Original requested Cohen's d was not printed for this comparison in the located original results; extracted printed omega squared without conversion. The original focal CMMS comparison was distinguished from the frame-by-scale interaction using the replication report's explicit main-claim description. Original text is a title-verified author-uploaded accepted manuscript; source cache preserves the retrieved full-text HTML window. Replication file is dated August 14, 2020 despite supplied reference date November 18, 2025 and lists Metzger/Mallik rather than all supplied reference authors; the supplied direct URL resolves to this final report. Replication focal ANOVA is printed F(1,261)=13.04, η²=.05, while its paired reported t-test is t(260)=-3.65, d=-0.23; extracted d and p from that same printed t-test without correcting apparent numerical inconsistencies. The report additionally states that the interaction did not replicate (p=.521); success classification reflects its explicit verdict on the focal CMMS claim. Quotes normalize PDF extraction spacing and remove formatting control characters.
